result.brief: 提出 Omni-Encoder：用单一共享 SigLIP-2 ViT 端到端联合训练图像、视频、音频与音视频表征，含 1D 卷积音频 tokenizer 与基于绝对时间戳的多模态 RoPE 统一时空坐标，并采用交替模态训练稳定联合优化。
result.reason: Shared-parameter multimodal encoder with audio tokenizer and timestamp-based RoPE for unified spatiotemporal alignment; contributes directly to visual/video representation learning and shared latent spaces.
